subject: Compile RStan model with clang++ (in lieu of g++)

messages.author: c25cbd5f6c1ac68c
messages.subject: Compile RStan model with clang++ (in lieu of g++)
parts:
Simple question. When fitting an RStan model, RStan first goes about compiling that model. On the shinyapps server, this compilation is done with g++ by default.

Is there are way to do this compilation with clang++ instead? With g++, the error I receive is as follows:

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Compile RStan model with clang++ (in lieu of g++)
parts:
It is not possible to use clang++ instead, as it is not available.

The version of g++ supports C++11, but not quite fully. A newer version of g++ will become available when we transition from Ubuntu 14.04 to 16.04 later this year.
